pages.title: Snow Underwater
pages.text: Marine snow makes coral restoration possible.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Feed muck, clay or mud and collect its native digestion output. Marine Snow revives coral and supports sponge growth; a water bucket transports the pig.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Transfer water with a redstone Drain and ascend with a Floater. The Drain needs liquid above and empty space below. Gossamer Worm Bioluminessence makes Floaters, underwater torches and Glowing potions. Light and glowing creatures attract Hullbreakers.
